Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left lane approaching an signalized intersection in Houston, Texas, when the
vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who was proceeding westbound and entered the intersection as
the light changed. Officers arrived to find both vehicles stopped in the roadway with visible crush damage to the
driver's door panel and the front quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle, damage consistent with the angle and force of a
side impact of this type. Driver 2 stated the collision occurred just as described by Driver 1, and two independent
witnesses at the corner gave statements that matched this account. Photographs taken at the scene show the
positions of both vehicles and the damage to each. Driver 1 was seen and identified at the scene by officers and by
the witnesses as present in the driver's seat at the time of impact, and Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder, an
injury officers considered plausible given how the vehicle was struck. No prior damage to the vehicle was noted in the
records checked. Passenger, seated in the rear, reported no injury and was transported by a separate vehicle. Driver
1 is listed as a named driver on the ploicy covering the vehicle.
